items.name: Able-Bodied
items.description: The Pokémon recovers from status conditions more slowly.
items.benefit: Extend its status-condition grace period by 2 rounds.

items.name: AC Up
items.description: The Pokémon gains a permanent defensive improvement.
items.benefit: Increase AC by 2; this bonus carries through evolution.

items.name: Ambidextrous
items.description: The Pokémon can manage more equipment at once.
items.benefit: It can hold one additional held item.
items.limit: This feat can be taken only once.

items.name: Combo Master
items.description: The Pokémon is more reliable with multi-hit Moves.
items.benefit: After a successful attack roll for a qualifying multi-hit Move, it is guaranteed to hit at least twice.

items.name: Extra Move
items.description: The Pokémon expands its known Move capacity.
items.benefit: Increase the number of known Moves by 1.
items.limit: It may be chosen again, up to a maximum of 6 known Moves.

items.name: Gifted
items.description: The Pokémon can push one attribute beyond the usual limit.
items.benefit: Increase one ability score by 1 and raise its maximum to 22.

items.name: Hidden Ability
items.description: The Pokémon unlocks the Hidden Ability shown in its stat block.
items.benefit: It gains access to its Hidden Ability in addition to its current standard Ability.

items.name: Melee Master
items.description: The Pokémon excels in close-range physical combat.
items.benefit: Gain advantage on opportunity attacks and add Proficiency bonus damage to a qualifying Strength-based melee Move once per turn.

items.name: Natural Mount
items.description: The Pokémon protects itself and its rider while serving as a mount.
items.benefit: It can redirect attacks from its rider to itself and improve selected Dexterity save outcomes for itself or its rider.

items.name: Power Sculpter
items.description: The Pokémon can shape area-of-effect Moves around allies.
items.benefit: Choose allies within range to automatically succeed on saving throws against its qualifying area Moves.

items.name: Ranged Master
items.description: The Pokémon is skilled at attacking from a distance.
items.benefit: Ranged Move attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover and do not have disadvantage from an adjacent enemy.

items.name: Terrain Adept
items.description: The Pokémon fights especially well in one chosen terrain.
items.benefit: Gain +3 to attack rolls while in the chosen terrain.
items.choice: Coastal, Swamp, Forest, Arctic, Desert, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, or Underwater.

items.name: Tireless
items.description: The Pokémon sustains its Moves for longer.
items.benefit: Increase PP by 1 for every current Move; replacement Moves receive the same bonus.

items.name: Wrangler
items.description: The Pokémon specializes in grappling and controlling nearby foes.
items.benefit: Gain advantage against grappled targets and may attempt a grapple after a qualifying Strength-based single-target melee Move once per turn.
